metadata.source: OpenStreetMap contributors / Geofabrik same-day Shanghai and Jiangsu extracts
metadata.areaMethod: Spherical polygon area using IUGG mean Earth radius 6371008.8 m; approximate, not cadastral area
metadata.method: Exact OSM node topology. Candidate roads are G1503-tagged operational motorway mainlines and motorway_link members of route relation/236871. Identify both directed closed carriageway cycles, validate geographic coverage, and select the smaller-area valid loop. No hull, rectangle, snapping, straight-line gap filling, repair or simplification.
metadata.northernClosure: Use operational G1503 Jiaohuan Tunnel and Puxi elevated approach, real Linghai interchange links, and Pudong G1503;S20 shared section. Use real Gaodong/Wuzhou interchange ramps. Exclude under-construction independent Pudong riverside G1503 viaduct.

westernSupplement.reason: About 2 km of the real G1503 road in Huaqiao is outside Geofabrik Shanghai crop

metadata.carriagewayChoice: Smaller-area operational direction; this is not guaranteed to be geometrically inset at every interchange
metadata.routeMemberOrder: First occurrence in the drivable directed cycle. GeoJSON exterior is oriented counterclockwise per RFC7946.

limitations: This is a reproducible product analysis area enclosed by mapped operating roads, not an official legal or administrative area.
The boundary follows one real directional carriageway rather than a surveyed motorway centerline; side-of-road differences are visible at ramps.
Current northern closure includes the Pudong S20 shared section; the independent G1503 Pudong riverside viaduct was still under construction in official 2026 sources.
The western Huaqiao gap in the Shanghai crop is supplied by four real ways from an identical-date Jiangsu extract, never by a straight chord.
OSM mapping and operational status can lag real roads. Snapshot-specific relation/route topology must be checked again before refreshing.
Area and perimeter are spherical approximations. The polygon is neither a navigable land mask nor a survey of highway right-of-way.
